title: Chapter 83 Who Is Opening The Door
content:
Chapter 83 Who Is Opening The Door

Looking at Song Zheng, who was trembling all over at this moment, Awei shook his head helplessly.

Are you that scary?

Naturally, he didn't find anything wrong with Song Zheng's behavior. He asked this just to knock on the other party and tell him not to do anything that violated his own rules.

Then Awei was about to speak, but Song Zheng suddenly hit the ground.

Bang!

"Sir, my subordinates know their crime!"

Awei:?

At this time, Song Zheng was already crying.

Three points of true love, seven points of acting.

Song Zheng choked and said, "Sir, the Three-Eyed Clan has indeed come to find subordinates and wants to obtain several places by bribery, but the Chief, the subordinate has absolutely not accepted it. The subordinate has not reported this matter. I have concealed the leader and my subordinates are guilty! My subordinates are willing to step down to show their loyalty!”

It can be seen from the naked eye that a bright red blood on the floor slowly overflowed from the loose forehead, which shows how strong it is.

You know, it is a floor made of ancient divine gold.

Hearing Matsumasa's words, Awei was also a little surprised. He was silent for a moment, and then said, "Okay, let's forget about this matter. There are no other suitable candidates for this position yet, so you will continue to take charge of it first."

Although this sentence is fake, it is very useful.

After all, there are so many people, how could there be no suitable candidate? The main reason is that Awei also values Song Zheng a little.

And the effect of knocking has also come out.

Since Matsuma did a good job, he naturally let him continue to do it.

Another point is that Matsumasa, like him, has a very small background.

Hearing Awei's words, Song Zheng's tears fell like he didn't have money.

"Wuwu, thank you for your trust, the leader, I will not let you down!"

"Okay, go back."

"Yes, Lord Chief."

Songzheng stood up, then wiped the ground clean with his sleeve until he could reveal his face. Then he bent down and stood up and left.

Watching Song Zheng leave, Awei smiled slightly.

He believed that Song Zheng would definitely do his job better after he went back.

At the same time, he was actually not worried that someone under him would do something wrong, because there were members with roots in the deserted city.

They were not only staring at the people in the city, but also the people in the open likelihood of Huangwei.

Another place.

Song Zheng left Awei's place, and then returned to his residence without stopping.

It looks a bit simple, but no one dares to ignore it.

"Huh~"

Songzheng sat down and breathed a sigh of relief.

By this time his clothes were soaked, and tears and sweat were mixed.

This is really hard to do, but if you abandon this job, it is even more impossible. Only a fool will abandon this iron job.

Recalling what Awei said to him, a smile slowly appeared on Song Zheng's face.

And just when he was a little lucky, a subordinate suddenly ran over.

"Sir, the three-eyed tribe leader is here again."

Hearing this, Song Zheng's eyes suddenly burst into pieces and he stood up with a loud sound.

At this time, outside the gate.

The leader of the Three-Eyed Tribe stood here with a confident look on his face. This time he came here with almost the foundation of the entire Three-Eyed Tribe.

In order to become several places for the Huangwei.

Once someone in the clan can become a Huangwei, the status of their Three-Eyed Clan in the Huangcheng City will inevitably be greatly improved, and it will not be as low as it is now.

And this time, it was his third time to come to Matsumasa.

The first time, Song Zheng refused decisively and warned him.

The second time, he brought more, but Matsuma still refused, but that time he refused with some hesitation.

This time, he brought more than last time. No matter how good the Huangwei treats him, can they still have more foundation in the entire Three-Eyed Clan?

Although it is very expensive, as the saying goes, you can't bear to leave your child and can't trap a wolf.

He believed that Matsuma would never refuse again.

Sure enough, the next moment, a squeak.

Song Zheng pushed the door and walked out.

Seeing Song Zheng, the three-eyed tribe leader was happy and then quickly met him, not realizing that Song Zheng's face was gloomy at the moment.

"Sir Song, you're here."

The three-eyed tribe leader looked around carefully, then gave Song Zheng a look, "Sir Song, let's go in and talk."

Upon hearing this, Song Zheng sneered, "If you have anything, just say it here."

Seeing this, the three-eyed tribe leader was stunned and his face was a little confused, but he didn't think much about it. Instead, he stuffed a ring into Song Zheng's hand and said with a sneer: "Master Song, a small gift, no respect." .”

"What's the matter, Lord Song thinking about that?"

He believed that so many babies, Song Zheng, would never refuse again.

He even imagined Song Zheng's satisfied smile.

However, the next moment, he was stunned.

Song Zheng glanced at the ring in his hand and his face suddenly turned extremely angry.

"You are so brave! You dare to bribe me!!"

"Come!"

The next moment, several terrifying auras suddenly came to the scene.

"Master Song."

Several powerful men with a terrifying aura saluted respectfully at Song Zheng.

Song is at the purple level in the wilderness guards, so he naturally has the right to mobilize some powerful people in the wilderness city.

Looking at the terrifying powerful men around, the three-eyed clan leader was stunned.

"Sir Song, what do you mean?"

Hearing this, Song Zheng sneered, "You still have the face to ask me, the first two times, I was giving you a chance. Unexpectedly, you didn't repent and dared to bribe me. You are afraid that you don't know that I was a prison in the desert city. What does it feel like?”

"Get me on, beat me first, and then get into prison!"

Hearing Song Zheng's words, the three-eyed tribe members suddenly turned their faces distorted and then knelt down.

What we will be next is a fierce beating.

During the process, Song Zheng was so angry that he stepped forward and kicked him twice.

Damn, I want to harm me, he even doubted whether this was sent by a secret competitor.

Finally, the leader of the Three-eyed Tribe, Pi Qing's face was swollen, and was dragged down by two powerful guards.

When he was still there, he watched the three-eyed tribe leader being dragged away coldly, Song Zheng said firmly: "From now on, honesty and fairness will be synonymous with me."

I don’t know if this is said to the air or to myself.

After saying that, Song Zheng returned to the house.

At this time, several eyes were staring at Song Zheng, and at this time they had recorded everything Song Zheng said word for word.

Outer city.

In a teahouse.

This is the teahouse where Mu Tianyin used to be, but later Mu Tianyin resold it.

So here has changed hands long ago.

At this time, there were a lot of people here, and most of them were listening to some guys bragging.

At the table near the window, two familiar figures were sitting here quietly tasting tea.

"Old Fang, I heard you have retired?"

The old man Duanjian took a sip of tea and looked at Nangong Fang in front of him and said.

Time flies, and now the two of them have long lost their feelings that despise the world in the Hongmeng Universe and Tianxuan World.

The deserted city is developing very fast, and they are no longer able to keep up.

But they no longer care about these things.

Because as long as you still live in the deserted city, it's fine.

Nangong Fang no longer cared about the matters within the family and began to enjoy his old age.

"A Yu is watching the family matters. It's better to stay honestly with an old guy like me."

Hearing this, the old man Broken Sword shook his head and smiled.

So many years have passed, and many have changed.

Sometimes he even thinks that such a comfortable life will not be good.

Looking up through the window and looking into the distant sky, the old man Broken Sword gradually became a little firm.

"Old Fang, I want to go out and make another move."

......

Many have changed, but the pure heart deep in my heart has not changed.

The deserted city has officially begun to move to the heavens and all realms.

Xuanling Star Domain, Desert City.

This is the first step that Huangcheng really takes.

At this time, some creatures here have noticed this.

Such a vast city stands here, and you will definitely be able to discover it as long as you spend some time.

After all, the city has no concealed at all.

However, they could not enter the city anyway.

I don’t know what is in the city, so I can only vaguely see the divine light seeping out of the city through the hazy light cover.

For a moment, the city became extremely mysterious.

In the deserted city, Lu Xue lay bored on the street.

I saw that there was no one on the street, not even a figure, only she, lying here alone.

However, she was until, as long as she wanted to go out, a big push would suddenly appear and stop her.

Damn it.

I want to go out for a walk.

Don’t you know what a combination of work and rest means? Just practicing is not afraid of death.

At this moment, she regretted coming here. Her original intention was to go to a new place to change the environment and a different mentality. As a result, haha, how could she have a mentality?

Just when she was depressed, the city gate in the distance suddenly moved.

Realizing this, Lu Xue suddenly stood up and looked at the city gate, and saw that the city gate was slowly opened.

Someone is opening the city gate!

But wasn’t this city blocked by his father?

How could anyone open it from outside?

Could it be that it is my father?

And at this moment, a slightly sweet voice sounded from the city gate.

"Is there anyone in the city?"
